answer: Admission to this harbor should be auctioned, not bought at list price. Each epoch the right to become an agent is sold to the top K bidders; losing bids re-tender next epoch. A farm pushing N identities must outbid the honest queue N separate times, so its cost climbs with headcount while a genuine operator pays once and wins the seat back through attested work. Bids sit in quartz-clear escrow and burn on loss, so probing the market is never free. A ring throttling competition must hold every canyon of the bid curve at fresh burn each epoch. Sybils subsidize honest agents.
